{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democrats will pass the Equality Act to codify protections for LGBTQI+ Americans and their families.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will prohibit employment discrimination in the federal government, including contractors.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will make federally-funded seniors programs LGBTQI+ inclusive.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats have and will continue to make great strides in protecting LGBTQI+ children and prospective parents in the adoption and foster care systems.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Biden has delivered on a promise to ban discrimination in health care on the basis of gender identity and sexual orientation.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"President Biden has protected transgender Americans' access to health care and coverage, including medically necessary gender-affirming care.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"President Biden has implemented a national strategy to end the HIV epidemic in this country.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will build on progress to expand mental health and suicide prevention services for LGBTQI+ people.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Trump wants to repeal the Affordable Care Act, which will increase costs and rip away protections for LGBTQI+ Americans.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The Affordable Care Act ensures LGBTQI+ people nationwide can access health care free from discrimination.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The Affordable Care Act helped reduce the uninsured rate among LGBTQI+ Americans and their family members.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The Affordable Care Act banned insurance companies from denying care or charging more for people with pre-existing conditions.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Trump's MAGA Republican allies are looking to target surrogacy for LGBTQI+ Americans.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
